evidence.title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation
Sparse Additive Off-Policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning with Potentially Limited Number of Trajectories

summary: Researchers introduce novel techniques for stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation in Q-learning and sparse additive off-policy evaluation in reinforcement learning. These methods address challenges in handling limited trajectories and improving evaluation robustness.
title: Advances in Reinforcement Learning: New Methods for Stable Function Approximation and Off-Policy Evaluation
